# pve_ha_arm (Action)

Arms or disarms the cluster HA stack. Arming re-enables the HA stack after it was disarmed. Disarming releases all watchdogs cluster-wide; HA-managed resources keep their current state unless `resource_mode` says otherwise. Both operations are synchronous on the API side.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Disarm the HA stack during maintenance: resources are frozen (no new
# commands or state changes are applied) until the stack is armed again.
action "pve_ha_arm" "maintenance" {
  config {
    armed         = false
    resource_mode = "freeze"
  }
}

# Re-arm the HA stack afterwards:
# action "pve_ha_arm" "rearm" {
#   config {
#     armed = true
#   }
# }
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `armed` (Boolean) Whether to arm (`true`) or disarm (`false`) the HA stack.

### Optional

- `resource_mode` (String) Only used when `armed` is `false`: controls how HA-managed resources are handled while disarmed. The current state of the resources is not affected. Must be one of: `freeze` (new commands and state changes are not applied), `ignore` (resources are removed from HA tracking and can be managed as if they were not HA-managed).
